Declare libraries

Reading input

the input to the model is all the annotations that EpiTox extracted from IEDB. For this target (MAGEA4), both HLA-ligand atlas and PEPREP contribution was subset of the IEDB whole annotation. See notes bellow to understand some of the decisions that were made.

The input is:

  • the final table from V2.5’s annotopes: HPA_genes_nTPM.xlsx

  • the experimental evidence file from the previous step

  • IEDB annotated peptides

Step 1: Estimate Experimental Evidence

The experimental evidence is a Baysian-based model to evaluate and summarize the context evidence that is available for each peptide. the concept is to determine the peptide with its protein ensuring context aware evaluation.

Notes

Experimental evidence

In the experimental evidence scoring, HLA-ligand Atlas and PEPREP were not used due to the following reasons:

  • PEPREP: At the time, data extraction was not possible from peprep and the schema was not stabilitzed enough to track down the information correctly

  • HLA-ligand atlas: at the time there was no real solution for the incomplete mapping between allele-tissue-peptide problem
